name: Subscription Manager
tagline: A running ledger of every renewal, with a nudge two days before each
description: Keeps a ledger of everything you pay for and pings you two days ahead of each renewal, so nothing renews by surprise. It makes up no entries on its own, as a charge only exists in the ledger because you logged it, and canceling anything at the vendor happens only when you say go.
author: c0rtex1100X
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
